name: How to Rescue a Reef LITE
summary: The “How to Rescue a Reef LITE” underwater experience emulates the real-world coral restoration expeditions led by the University of Miami Rosenstiel School’s (UM) Rescue a Reef program. Rescue a Reef (RAR) is UM’s coral conservation program designed to build community and coastal resilience through coral reef education, restoration, and citizen science. To accomplish this, RAR hosts public field expeditions led by UM coral scientists that provide a unique, hands-on opportunity for recreational SCUBA divers
